elements.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
elements.evidence: M&I is expressly a “non-exclusive provider,” Customer may use any other provider for Bankcard Services data processing, and Customer is not required to obtain any Services from M&I.

elements.element: Exclusivity is limited to a defined product category.
elements.evidence: No exclusivity applies to any product category; the rendered clause expressly makes M&I non-exclusive.

elements.element: Exclusivity lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: Customer has no exclusivity obligation at any time, which is necessarily no longer than 12 months.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet service levels.
elements.evidence: There is no exclusivity to survive a service-level failure; Customer remains free to use other providers regardless of M&I’s performance.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet delivery dates.
elements.evidence: There is no exclusivity to survive a delivery-date failure; Customer remains free to use other providers regardless of M&I’s performance.
